collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A researcher wants to build a stone circle to measure the seasons by the sun: build it, or keep using the old signs.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has worked out that if the village set stones in a great circle, the sunrise would line up with different stones as the seasons change, and the farmers would know exactly when to plant. (friend) says the farmers already know when to plant: when the red flowers bloom. What should the village do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village builds the stone circle on the headland. It takes a season. The first time the sunrise lines up with the planting stone, the red flowers bloom the same week. Both (subject) and (friend) are right. The circle becomes a place for gatherings too.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village keeps the red flowers. (subject) builds a small circle by (subject.him/her)self, out of pebbles, and writes down the sunrises. Years later, when the red flowers bloom late after a strange year, (subject)'s pebbles are right.
